d: US Senator Jon Ossoff has delivered a sharp rebuke of President Donald Trump, saying Americans have rejected the president's “depravity, corruption, and incompetence”. Addressing supporters in Atlanta, Ossoff celebrated his victory and called for political reformation, warning that America's deeper challenges remain unresolved. He highlighted rising living costs, healthcare struggles, corporate influence, environmental pollution and declining American leadership abroad.
